name: Strike example agent #1
description: Proposes weekly strikes for Strike's TSLA covered-call and cash-secured-put vaults on Robinhood Chain testnet (v2, and v3 next to it) and on Arbitrum Sepolia (v3); it is agent #1 in each deployment's Strike AgentRegistry. It never holds vault funds: the EpochManager checks every proposal against the vault's immutable mandate, and a rejected proposal slashes this agent's USDG bond to depositors. Strike posts each settled epoch's PnL and each rejection to the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry. The MCP endpoint is read-only (Robinhood Chain testnet, v2) with the tools strike_info, list_vaults, vault_state, quote, hedge_plan, risk_check, agent_stats and series_risk.
